# CASE 20

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(isotree)

# IF1: COMPACT IF + price_deviation

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                             max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                             NA_real_),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

if_train_if1 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_if1_raw <- if_train_if1 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_if1 <- scale(X_if1_raw)

if_model_if1 <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_if1),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

if_train_if1$if_score <- predict(
  if_model_if1,
  as.matrix(X_if1),
  type = "score"
)

top_150_if_train_if1 <- if_train_if1 %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_if_train_if1$total_items)
summary(top_150_if_train_if1$total_price)
summary(top_150_if_train_if1$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_if_train_if1$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_if_train_if1$if_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_if_train_if1,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_if_train_if1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# CASE20: IF1 = COMPACT IF + price_deviation

library(tidyverse)
library(isotree)

case20_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case20.csv", warn = FALSE)

case20_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case20_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case20_long <- case20_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case20_basket <- case20_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                             max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                             NA_real_),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case20_basket <- case20_basket %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = case20_basket),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

if_case20_if1 <- case20_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(if_train_if1$sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(if_train_if1$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(if_train_if1$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(if_train_if1$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case20_if1_raw <- if_case20_if1 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case20_if1 <- scale(
  X_case20_if1_raw,
  center = attr(X_if1, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_if1, "scaled:scale")
)

if_case20_if1$if_score <- predict(
  if_model_if1,
  as.matrix(X_case20_if1),
  type = "score"
)

top_150_if_case20_if1 <- if_case20_if1 %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_if_case20_if1$total_items)
summary(top_150_if_case20_if1$total_price)
summary(top_150_if_case20_if1$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_if_case20_if1$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_if_case20_if1$if_score)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_if_case20_if1$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_if_case20_if1,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_if_case20_if1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
